question: In a Dutch survey, what share of parents of six-month-olds admitted shaking, slapping or smothering their crying baby?
answer: About one in twenty. Between 4.2% and 7.0% said they had done at least one of these at least once because of the crying, and the risk rose when the crying seemed excessive. A cry is built to summon care and usually does; past a limit, it can summon harm.
move: Any alarm loud enough to compel help can also wear out the helper.
reference: Vingerhoets, Why Only Humans Weep: Unravelling the Mysteries of Tears, Oxford University Press, 2013
